question: When performing the conventional parallel parking exercise on the CDL basic control skills test, what must you accomplish?
choice_a: Park with only the front of the vehicle inside the marked boundaries
choice_b: Drive past the space, then back in without crossing the front, side, or rear boundaries marked by cones, getting your entire vehicle completely into the space
choice_c: Back in diagonally without using cones as reference
choice_d: Complete the maneuver without ever stopping the vehicle
explanation: The manual states you must drive past the entrance to the space, back in without crossing front, side, or rear boundaries marked by cones, and get your entire vehicle completely into the space.

question: In the alley dock exercise, how close must the rear of the vehicle come to the rear of the alley, and what must be avoided?
choice_a: Within ten feet, and cones may be lightly touched
choice_b: Exactly at the boundary line, with no tolerance
choice_c: Within three feet of the rear of the alley, without touching boundary lines or cones
choice_d: Within one foot, and the vehicle may end up angled in the alley
explanation: The manual requires backing into the alley so the rear of the vehicle is within three feet of the rear of the alley, without touching boundary lines or cones, and finishing straight within the alley/lane.

topic: On-Road Driving Test - How You Will Be Tested
question: During the on-road driving test, which of the following are you required to do at all times?
choice_a: Wear your safety belt and obey all traffic signs, signals, and laws
choice_b: Maintain a speed at least 5 mph above the posted limit to match traffic flow
choice_c: Wait for written confirmation before following each examiner instruction
choice_d: Complete the route within a strict time limit set before the test begins
explanation: The manual states that at all times during the test you must wear your safety belt, obey all traffic signs, signals, and laws, and complete the test without an accident or moving violation.
source_note: Section 13.1, How You Will Be Tested

question: As defined in the manual, when does "unsafe coasting" occur while approaching a turn?
choice_a: Whenever you decelerate before reaching the turn
choice_b: When you use your turn signal earlier than necessary
choice_c: Any time you shift gears while approaching an intersection
choice_d: When your vehicle is out of gear (clutch depressed or gearshift in neutral) for more than the length of your vehicle
explanation: The manual explicitly defines unsafe coasting as your vehicle being out of gear, clutch depressed or gearshift in neutral, for more than the length of your vehicle.

question: If you must stop before making a turn, where does the manual say you should come to a complete stop?
choice_a: As close to the intersection as possible, even if past the stop line
choice_b: Behind the stop line, crosswalk, or stop sign
choice_c: At least two car lengths before any stop line
choice_d: Wherever traffic allows, without regard to markings
explanation: The manual instructs you to come to a smooth, complete stop behind the stop line, crosswalk, or stop sign before making the turn.

question: After completing a turn, what actions does the manual require regarding your turn signal and lane position?
choice_a: Leave the turn signal on until the next intersection as a courtesy
choice_b: Immediately accelerate to the maximum posted speed limit
choice_c: Make sure the turn signal is off, get up to the speed of traffic, and move into the right-most lane when safe (if not already there)
choice_d: Remain in the left lane until directed otherwise by the examiner
explanation: After the turn, the manual requires confirming the turn signal is off, getting up to the speed of traffic, and moving into the right-most lane when safe, along with checking mirrors and traffic.

question: When coming to a complete stop at an intersection, what must your vehicle avoid doing?
choice_a: Rolling forward or backward
choice_b: Signaling before the stop
choice_c: Checking traffic in all directions
choice_d: Braking smoothly and shifting gears if necessary
explanation: The manual states that when stopping at an intersection, your vehicle must not roll forward or backward.

question: While driving through an intersection during the test, which action is prohibited?
choice_a: Decelerating and yielding to pedestrians and traffic in the intersection
choice_b: Keeping your hands on the wheel
choice_c: Checking traffic thoroughly in all directions
choice_d: Changing lanes while proceeding through the intersection
explanation: The manual specifically states you should not change lanes while proceeding through the intersection.

question: During the urban business portion of the on-road test, where should your vehicle be positioned and how should your speed compare to traffic?
choice_a: Centered in the left lane, always at the exact posted speed limit
choice_b: Centered in the right-most lane, keeping up with the flow of traffic but not exceeding the posted speed limit
choice_c: In any open lane, at least 10 mph below the posted limit
choice_d: Straddling two lanes to prepare for upcoming turns
explanation: The manual states your vehicle should be centered in the proper (right-most) lane and you should keep up with the flow of traffic but not exceed the posted speed limit.

question: What is the correct order of actions when changing lanes during the multiple-lane portion of the on-road test?
choice_a: Signal first, then check traffic while already changing lanes
choice_b: Change lanes immediately, then signal to alert nearby drivers
choice_c: Make the necessary traffic checks first, then use proper signals and smoothly change lanes when safe
choice_d: Change lanes only when directly told to, without any traffic checks
explanation: The manual states you should make the necessary traffic checks first, then use proper signals and smoothly change lanes when it is safe to do so.

topic: On-Road Driving Test - Expressway or Rural Highway
question: Before entering the expressway, what does the manual instruct you to do?
choice_a: Check traffic, use proper signals, and merge smoothly into the proper lane of traffic
choice_b: Come to a complete stop at the on-ramp before merging
choice_c: Accelerate to maximum highway speed before checking traffic
choice_d: Change lanes multiple times to find the least congested lane
explanation: The manual lists checking traffic, using proper signals, and merging smoothly into the proper lane of traffic as the steps before entering the expressway.
source_note: Section 13.1.5, Expressway or Rural/Limited Access Highway

topic: On-Road Driving Test - Expressway or Rural Highway
question: Once on the exit ramp of an expressway, what must you continue to do?
choice_a: Accelerate to match the speed of highway traffic
choice_b: Change lanes as needed to pass slower vehicles
choice_c: Stop immediately at the start of the ramp
choice_d: Decelerate within the lane markings and maintain adequate spacing between your vehicle and other vehicles
explanation: The manual states that once on the exit ramp, you must continue to decelerate within the lane markings and maintain adequate spacing between your vehicle and other vehicles.
source_note: Section 13.1.5, Expressway or Rural/Limited Access Highway

question: For the stop/start maneuver on the on-road test, what are you asked to do?
choice_a: Perform an emergency stop from highway speed
choice_b: Pull the vehicle over to the side of the road and stop as if you were going to get out and check something on your vehicle
choice_c: Shut off and restart the engine at a designated point
choice_d: Back the vehicle into a marked space
explanation: The manual describes the stop/start maneuver as pulling the vehicle over to the side of the road and stopping as if you were going to get out and check something on the vehicle.

question: When approaching a curve, what should you do before entering it, according to the manual?
choice_a: Accelerate slightly to maintain momentum through the curve
choice_b: Shift into neutral to coast through the curve smoothly
choice_c: Reduce speed so that further braking or shifting is not required in the curve
choice_d: Move into the oncoming lane to straighten the curve's angle
explanation: The manual states that before entering the curve, you should reduce speed so further braking or shifting is not required in the curve, and keep the vehicle in the lane.

question: Before reaching a railroad crossing, what should all commercial drivers do?
choice_a: Decelerate, brake smoothly and shift gears as necessary, and look and listen for the presence of trains
choice_b: Come to a complete stop at every crossing regardless of signals
choice_c: Activate the four-way flashers only if hauling placarded cargo
choice_d: Change lanes to obtain a clearer view of the tracks
explanation: The manual states that before reaching the crossing, all commercial drivers should decelerate, brake smoothly and shift gears as necessary, and look and listen for the presence of trains while checking traffic.

question: If driving a bus, school bus, or a vehicle displaying placards, within what distance from the nearest rail must you stop at a non-exempt railroad crossing?
choice_a: Exactly at the nearest rail
choice_b: Within 100 feet but not less than 50 feet
choice_c: Within 15 feet but not less than 5 feet
choice_d: Within 50 feet but not less than 15 feet
explanation: The manual specifies that such vehicles should stop the vehicle within 50 feet but not less than 15 feet from the nearest rail at every non-exempt railroad crossing.

question: After the on-road test route takes you under an overpass and over a bridge, what might the examiner ask you to identify for each?
choice_a: The posted weight limit after the overpass, and the posted clearance after the bridge
choice_b: The posted clearance or height after the overpass, and the posted weight limit after the bridge
choice_c: The construction date for both the overpass and the bridge
choice_d: The toll amount for both structures
explanation: The manual states that after driving under an overpass you may be asked for the posted clearance or height, and after going over a bridge you may be asked for the posted weight limit.

question: As you approach a student pick-up location for the student discharge maneuver (School Bus endorsement), what must you do?
choice_a: Immediately activate the stop arm and red warning lights before decelerating
choice_b: Come to a complete stop at least 50 feet from the students with flashers on
choice_c: Decelerate and approach at a slow rate of speed while checking traffic, then activate amber warning lights and right turn signals
choice_d: Signal a left turn regardless of where the pickup is located
explanation: The manual states that as you approach the student pick up, you must decelerate and approach at a slow rate of speed while checking traffic, then activate amber warning lights and right turn signals.

topic: On-Road Driving Test - General Driving Behaviors: Clutch Usage
question: For a manual transmission vehicle, what does the manual require regarding clutch usage during the on-road test?
choice_a: Always use the clutch to shift, and double-clutch when shifting, without revving or lugging the engine
choice_b: Ride the clutch to help control vehicle speed
choice_c: Coast with the clutch depressed between shifts
choice_d: "Pop" the clutch for faster gear changes
explanation: The manual states you must always use the clutch to shift and must double-clutch when shifting, without revving or lugging the engine, and prohibits riding the clutch, coasting with it depressed, or popping it.

topic: On-Road Driving Test - General Driving Behaviors: Gear Usage
question: Regarding gear usage during the on-road test, which practice is specifically prohibited?
choice_a: Selecting a gear that avoids revving or lugging the engine
choice_b: Shifting gears before approaching an intersection
choice_c: Downshifting on a decline
choice_d: Shifting gears while in turns and intersections
explanation: The manual states you must not grind or clash gears, must select a gear that does not rev or lug the engine, and must not shift in turns and intersections.

topic: On-Road Driving Test - General Driving Behaviors: Brake Usage
question: What does the manual say about proper brake usage on the on-road test?
choice_a: Pump the brake repeatedly for a controlled stop
choice_b: Do not ride or pump the brake; brake smoothly using steady pressure
choice_c: Ride the brake lightly on downgrades to control speed
choice_d: Brake harshly to demonstrate stopping ability
explanation: The manual states you must not ride or pump the brake, must not brake harshly, and must brake smoothly using steady pressure.

topic: On-Road Driving Test - General Driving Behaviors: Lane Usage
question: On a multiple-lane road, where should you finish a left turn according to the lane usage scoring criteria, and where should a right turn finish?
choice_a: Left turn in the right-most lane; right turn in the lane directly right of the center line
choice_b: Left turn in any open lane; right turn in the left-most lane
choice_c: Left turn in the lane directly to the right of the center line; right turn in the right-most (curb) lane
choice_d: Both turns should finish in the center lane regardless of direction
explanation: The manual states the vehicle should finish a left turn in the lane directly to the right of the center line, and finish a right turn in the right-most (curb) lane.
